title: SOX Control Documentation Missing for 3 Acquisitions
description: PaySpace, PayGroup, and Hofy acquisitions lack complete SOX control documentation. IPO readiness blocked until Q1 2025. Audit committee flagging this as critical gap.
resolutionNotes: Documentation sprint planned for Q1. External auditors engaged.

title: Contractor Payments Delayed in 12 LATAM Countries
description: Banking integration issues causing 24-48hr payment delays affecting 500+ contractors monthly. Customer complaints increasing. Churn risk in key markets.
resolutionNotes: Root cause identified: API timeout issues with local banks. Fix in testing.

title: APAC Customer Support Response Times 3x Target
description: Timezone coverage gaps causing 18+ hour response times for APAC customers. Churn risk increasing. Need 3 APAC-based support reps urgently.
resolutionNotes: 3 roles opened. Target hire date: Feb 1, 2025.

title: Duplicate Employee Records Across 4 HRIS Systems
description: Post-acquisition employee data exists in Deel, PaySpace, PayGroup, and Hofy systems. Causing payroll errors, compliance risks, and data integrity issues.

title: IPO Readiness Dashboard Shows 37% Control Gap
description: SOX 404 compliance tracking shows only 63% of required controls documented. External audit in 8 weeks. Need emergency sprint to close gap.
resolutionNotes: War room established. Daily standups with exec team. 2-week sprint planned.

title: Brazil Tax Withholding Calculations Incorrect for 6 Months
description: Automated tax calculation bug affected 1200+ contractors. Need to file corrections and potentially issue refunds. Legal exposure estimated at $2M+.
resolutionNotes: Legal assessing exposure. Engineering building correction tool. Customer comms drafted.

title: Weekly Exec Meeting Has 23 Attendees - Nothing Gets Decided
description: Leadership meeting bloated to 23 people. No decisions made in 6 weeks. Need to restructure decision-making process urgently.

title: India Payroll Run Failed - 2400 Employees Not Paid
description: Technical issue with Indian banking partner. Payroll for 2400 employees 48 hours late. Urgent communication and resolution needed to prevent attrition.
resolutionNotes: Emergency wire transfers processed. Root cause: API timeout. Monitoring added. Post-mortem completed.

title: France Compliance Audit Found 12 Contractor Misclassifications
description: French labor authorities flagged 12 workers as misclassified. Potential fines €50K+ per violation (€600K+ total). Need immediate remediation plan.
resolutionNotes: Labor law firm engaged. Reclassification plan in progress. Weekly updates to authorities.

title: Customer Data Breach - 47 Accounts Accessed Via Legacy Login
description: Old PaySpace accounts still active with weak password requirements. Attacker accessed 47 customer accounts. Incident response initiated. PR risk high.
resolutionNotes: All legacy accounts disabled. Affected customers notified. Security audit underway. No data exfiltration detected.

title: Product Roadmap Has 47 P0 Items - Everything is Urgent
description: No prioritization framework post-M&A. Engineering teams don't know what to build. Roadmap paralysis affecting velocity and morale.

title: Salesforce and HubSpot Not Syncing - Duplicate Customer Records
description: M&A created two CRM systems. 400+ duplicate customer records. Sales and CS using different data. Revenue reporting broken. Forecast accuracy compromised.
resolutionNotes: Integration project scoped. 6-week timeline. Interim manual deduplication process.

title: Global All-Hands Meeting at 2pm GMT Excludes All of APAC
description: Meeting time works for EU and US but 11pm-2am for APAC. 1200 employees never attend. Cultural divide growing. Inclusion concerns raised.
resolutionNotes: Rotating all-hands schedule implemented. APAC-friendly time added monthly. Recordings with APAC-specific Q&A.

title: API Rate Limiting Causing Partner Integration Failures
description: Deel API rate limits too low for large enterprise customers with 5000+ employees. 6 customers experiencing daily failures. Enterprise sales pipeline at risk.
resolutionNotes: Rate limit increase deployed for affected customers. Long-term scaling solution in development.

title: Nigeria License Application Stalled for 9 Months
description: Government approvals stuck in bureaucracy. Cannot onboard new Nigerian customers. 8 enterprise deals worth $2M ARR blocked. Competitors gaining ground.
resolutionNotes: Local counsel engaged. Political connections activated. Weekly status updates to blocked customers.
